shortDescription: Federal regulators have approved Cheniere Energy's NYSE:LNG application to expand its Sabine Pass liquefied natural gas plant by 20 million metric tons per annum.The three train expansion project was approved by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) on Thursday.
